title: Treatment With Phosphodiesterase 5 Inhibitors and Long‐Term Outcomes in Patients Undergoing Coronary Angiography and Cardiac Catheterization
abstract: The effects of phosphodiesterase 5 (PDE5) inhibitors on the incidence of long‐term outcomes in patients with cardiovascular disease are not well understood. Objective: We studied the association between PDE5 inhibitor therapy and the incidence of adverse cardiovascular major adverse cardiovascular events (MACE) in patients undergoing coronary angiography and intervention.
